query: Which farm records should a new farmer keep first?
expected_question: What farm records should a beginner start with?
expected_answer: Start with crop area, planting date, seed used, major inputs, labour, harvest quantity, sales and major expenses.
returned_question: How should I keep records for my farm?
returned_answer: Keep a simple farm diary or notebook. Record planting dates, inputs purchased and costs, labor hired and paid, crop activities, harvest quantities, and sales. Simple mobile apps or voice memos on your phone can help record activities easily.

query: How can I successfully produce plenty of tomatoes in Ghana?
expected_question: How can I grow tomatoes successfully in Ghana for high yield?
expected_answer: Start tomato seedlings in a nursery bed for 3 to 4 weeks before transplanting. Prepare fertile well-drained beds with compost. Transplant seedlings at 60 by 60 cm spacing in the late afternoon to avoid heat stress. Apply NPK fertilizer at planting and top dress with calcium nitrate to prevent blossom end rot. Water regularly especially during fruit set. Most varieties take 60 to 80 days from transplanting to harvest.
